cash_amount.description: The signed cash effect: −signed_quantity × execution_pu for a trade (spec §7.3), the amount for a cash entry
cash_amount.title: Cash Amount

description.description: The aporte's or retirada's text, or null (OQ-51)
description.title: Description

CreateInstrumentIn.description:
``POST /instruments``. ``maturity_date`` is always sent; ``null`` is accepted here because
whether a maturity is required depends on the product's type, which the service checks.
CreateInstrumentIn.title: CreateInstrumentIn

CreateLedgerEntryBody.description:
``POST /ledger/entries``: a TRADE (contract, signed quantity, and the PU or the rate named
by ``input_kind``) or a CASH entry (signed ``cash_amount`` and an optional ``description``,
OQ-51).

description.description: CASH only: trimmed, blank as null, at most 200 characters
description.title: Description

CreateLedgerEntryBody.title: CreateLedgerEntryBody

CreateProductIn.description:
``POST /products`` (interfaces.md "HTTP endpoints"). ``futures`` is required exactly for a
product whose type is FUTURE, which the service checks.
CreateProductIn.title: CreateProductIn

InputKind.description: The authoritative input; the other value of the pair is calculated (DC/365).
InputKind.title: InputKind

IssueType.description: The two Pendências of spec §10.3 (OQ-19, OQ-31).
IssueType.title: IssueType

LastReferenceOut.description:
The instrument's latest preferred reference price, always shown with its own date, never
as today's price (OQ-48, OQ-19 item 5).
LastReferenceOut.title: LastReferenceOut

PnlPointOut.description: One calendar date of the range, processed or not (OQ-41, OQ-49).
PnlPointOut.title: PnlPointOut

PredecessorState.description:
The day before a date, for one chain: its recorded status in ``date_status``, or, without
one, NOT_PROCESSED or ZERO_STATE (the chain has nothing on or before it). There is no
stale state (OQ-31).
PredecessorState.title: PredecessorState

PriceSource.description: Where a reference observation came from. MANUAL wins over B3 on the same date (spec §5).
PriceSource.title: PriceSource

ProcessingChain.description: One of the two daily chains (OQ-21).
ProcessingChain.title: ProcessingChain

ProcessingScope.description:
Which chain a request processes (OQ-21; schema ``requests.scope``). ALL publishes both
in one transaction.
ProcessingScope.title: ProcessingScope

ProcessingStatus.description:
The eight run statuses (spec §10.3; schema ``requests_status_check``); there is no
SUPERSEDED since OQ-23. DISPATCHED and CANCELLING are never set since OQ-46: a request goes
QUEUED → RUNNING when the worker takes it, and a cancel of a RUNNING run only records
``cancel_requested_at``. The two values stay only because the schema's CHECK and the API
enum keep them (user decision); no code reads or writes them, and no row holds them.
ProcessingStatus.title: ProcessingStatus

ReferencePriceDayList.description: ``ListResponse<ReferencePriceDay>``: newest date first, dates without a price absent.
ReferencePriceDayList.title: ReferencePriceDayList

ReferencePriceDayResponse.description:
``ReferencePriceDay`` of the contract: the preferred price (MANUAL > B3) and each
source's price of one date.
ReferencePriceDayResponse.title: ReferencePriceDayResponse

SetReferencePriceBody.description:
``POST /reference-prices``: a MANUAL price typed as a PU or as a rate. One flat model, so a
field error names ``pu`` or ``rate`` as the client sent it.
SetReferencePriceBody.title: SetReferencePriceBody
